title: What Is Dogecoin? The Joke Coin With No Supply Cap (30 Seconds)

scenes.head: COIN EXPLAINER
scenes.hook: WHAT IS DOGECOIN? IT STARTED AS A JOKE
scenes.narration: What is Dogecoin? It started as a joke.

scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
scenes.narration: Two engineers launched Dogecoin in December twenty thirteen, adapting Litecoin's code. It was meant for fun and tipping.

scenes.head: THE IDEA
scenes.hook: MINERS ADD A NEW BLOCK EVERY MINUTE
scenes.narration: It uses proof of work. Miners confirm payments, and a new block arrives about every minute, much faster than Bitcoin.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.hook: NO CAP: NEW COINS KEEP BEING CREATED
scenes.narration: There is no maximum supply, so new coins keep appearing. Its price also swings with social media hype.
